scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" vite.config.ts index.html package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" vite.config.ts index.html package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
